title: lettersPattern
summary: Create a pattern matching letter characters.

gpu_support.notes: The returned pattern is host metadata. Automatically resident numeric count controls gather transparently; explicit gpuArray count controls are unsupported.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes host text or logical results.

description: `lettersPattern` creates a greedy pattern for one or more Unicode letters by default, or for an exact or inclusive bounded count.

inputs.name: N
inputs.description: Exact nonnegative number of letters to match.

inputs.name: maxCharacters
inputs.description: Inclusive nonnegative maximum, or positive infinity.

behaviors: Without a count, the greedy pattern matches one or more Unicode alphabetic characters.
Exact and bounded counts accept single, double, and all eight integer classes without routing typed values through floating compatibility storage.
The bounded form accepts positive infinity as the maximum and rejects negative, fractional, nonscalar, reversed, or platform-oversized counts.
examples: startsWith("abc1", lettersPattern) can match the leading letters.
